english: Armies eat the provisions they carry once a turn. In your own settlements they refill from the stores, never below what a settlement keeps: Auto keeps 5 turns, and Load fills the army to 10. At sea, or with no settlements, Load buys two meals at 10 gold each, once a turn. Armies cannot refill in foreign lands. Missed meals hurt an army. Caravans and convoys carry none. This is fixed when a campaign starts: changing it later does nothing to a campaign already under way. In multiplayer it is always on.

english: Every unit you recruit takes resources from your stores by its type and worth (cavalry and monsters take mounts, infantry and war machines take war materials, the finest also take your rare resource). What the stores lack is paid in your race's own currency where it has one. A recruit whose resources are still short arrives understrength, unless Gold pays for recruits is ticked. Off: recruiting takes nothing.

Replenishment cost

Strength a unit regains takes resources from your stores, as a share of what recruiting it takes: at 100, a unit that regains half its strength takes half its recruit's resources. Strength your stores cannot pay for is lost again. 0 turns this off.
Other factions restock for recruits

Each settlement of a faction no player controls is topped up, every turn, with the resources its recruits and replenishment use: up to 6 war materials, 3 mounts and 2 building materials for each settlement level. Off: it has only what its buildings make and its trade brings.
Gold pays for recruits

What a recruit's resources and your race's currency do not cover is paid in gold, as before. Off: the recruit arrives understrength instead, and must regain the rest by replenishing. A faction no player controls always pays in gold.
Hunger weakens armies

After two missed meals an army's units lose 5% of their strength each turn. After three they lose 10% and regain nothing. After five, one unit deserts each turn. A full meal ends this. An army that still carries 5 turns of provisions after eating is Well fed: leadership +4 and replenishment +5%. Off: missed meals slow the army and its replenishment instead, and no army is Well fed.
